convert_llama_model_to_gguf: convert a LLaMA model from PyTorch or safetensors format to a GGUF compatible file
extract_vocab_only_from_model: extract only the vocabulary from a LLaMA model and write it to a GGUF file
load_model_from_any_format: load a LLaMA model from PyTorch, safetensors, or GGML format with lazy tensor loading
quantize_model_to_q8_0: quantize a LLaMA model tensor from F32 to Q8_0 format using block quantization
merge_sharded_model_tensors: merge sharded model tensors from multiple files into a single lazy model
